features.title: Flat £4 Delivery
features.text: £4.00 per order to the UK and 30+ countries. Most orders arrive within 2-7 days.

promises.title: Friendly Customer Support
promises.text: Our friendly team is here to help before, during and after your purchase.

promises.title: International Delivery
promises.text: We deliver across the UK and to 30+ countries, including the EU, US, Canada and Australia.

promises.title: Shop with Confidence
promises.text: Secure checkout, delivery options shown before you pay, and friendly support from order to doorstep.

faq.a: Most orders arrive within 2-7 days. Items are dispatched from our partner warehouses, and busy periods or customs checks can add a few days. Contact us any time for an update on your order.

faq.q: Do you deliver across the UK and internationally?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver across the UK and to 30+ countries, including the EU, US, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. Delivery options and costs are shown at checkout.
Delivery is a flat £4.00 per order, the same whether you buy one item or several. You will see it at checkout before you pay.
Most items are dispatched from our partner warehouses overseas, which is why we quote 2-7 days rather than next-day delivery.

faq.q: How do I place an order?
faq.a: Choose the product you want, add it to your basket and proceed to secure checkout. We accept Apple Pay, Google Pay and all major cards.
